Decoders can thus pool weak word-level EEG evidence across the sentence through explicit lexical and grammatical structure, with the language model adjudicating among candidates rather than generating them, which lowers decoding cost and keeps decisions inspectable.
papers.tldr: EEGHyena2は、自然な読書中の脳波（EEG）からの語彙的および文法的証拠を活用し、言語モデルが候補を生成するのではなく評価することで、EEGからテキストへのデコードを効率化し、従来の手法を上回る性能を示しました。

papers.title: A predictive, per-engine energy roofline of the Apple Neural Engine
papers.summary: The Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is in over a billion devices, but is characterized indirectly via CoreML. Using a CoreML-free fused-graph dispatch path, we measure the ANE, along with the Apple GPU and CPU on the same device, with per-engine energy accounting. The consumer-available roofline does not predict the ANE in practice. A critical correction is that the ANE sees two effective memory bandwidths: a slow activation path and a fast weight-stream path. Two roofline ridges follow, and the weight-stream ridge is below that of the GPU. The ANE single-operand compute peak decreases instead of plateauing. Its weight stream is byte-bound in fp16 but limited by the dequantizer's element rate in int8. As a result, int8 compression saves energy at unchanged throughput and an int4 lookup-table stream raises throughput and efficiency at a cost of 2.55 points of ImageNet top-1. The corrected roofline identifies the lower-energy ANE paths and bounds it from below. A constructed device map reproduces across four unique ANE generations. Results show that operators should be placed by arithmetic intensity and fused for optimal performance.
papers.tldr: Apple Neural Engine（ANE）のエネルギー効率を測定した結果、従来の屋根線モデルではANEの性能を正確に予測できず、ANEは異なるメモリ帯域幅を持つことが明らかになった。最適なパフォーマンスを得るためには、演算強度に基づいてオペレーターを配置し、融合させる必要がある。

papers.title: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
papers.summary: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.
papers.tldr: 大学の教員が設計したAIが、19の大学で行われたランダム化試験において学生の学習を改善することが示された。教員が自らの授業に最適なAIソリューションを開発することで、学生の成績が向上したが、学生のエンゲージメントや満足度には変化が見られなかった。

papers.title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
papers.summary: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/BurakSevsay/DEFDVO
papers.tldr: DEFDVOは、360度カメラのequirectangular画像に特化した深層視覚オドメトリ手法で、歪みや境界のシームを考慮しつつ、合成データを用いて従来の手法に比べて4.8倍の精度向上を達成しました。
